method: 25full and5face checkpoints plus feet sampled every6frames over all241native frames; not continuous playback.

observations.camera: Near-side-profile parallel tracking remains throughout, with coherent lateral movement of crossing stripes and office/tree background. Does not reuse45degree view.
observations.walking: Repeated alternating leg advancement, foot lift/heel-to-toe landings and natural skirt response visible in sampled temporal sequence; not static weight-shift. Source remains real-time; perceived briskness requires user playback.
observations.pose: Head follows walking direction; profile remains readable rather than turning toward camera.
observations.wardrobe: White pointed-collar short sleeves, tucked waist, black calf-length A-line skirt, cobalt bag and plain black low heels retained; no added bow/slit in inspected frames.
observations.background_commuters: Multiple commuters walk through deeper lanes and enter/leave frame, more than3-4 at some times; no inspected main-outfit occlusion or clear sudden identity replacement/geometry collapse. Small rear people remain a visual-QA risk.
observations.identity: M03 near-profile remains recognizable at checkpoints; no instant face swap seen in samples.
observations.cadence_goal: 18-20footfalls/10s was requested; exact footfalls not confidently measured, not claimed achieved.

selection_rationale: Whole outfit readable and side-tracking established at start; avoid unnecessary later source while testing new source language. Actual join comfort still to be checked.
